hero.title: A clock on your side.
hero.body: Waiting for cashless approval? Save the time. Get it in writing. Know what to send next.
hero.private: No login. Your hospital details stay on this device.
start.title: When did the desk send your request?
start.subtitle: Use the time the hospital says it submitted to the insurer or TPA.
start.note: This records what you tell us. A written acknowledgement helps support it.
clock.title: Your cashless clock
clock.remaining: Estimated time left in the rule’s window
clock.overdue: Recorded wait beyond the rule’s window
clock.enhancement: No separate enhancement deadline has been verified. We can still record your wait.
clock.basis: Estimated from the desk’s reported submission. The rule runs from receipt by the insurer. Ask for written confirmation of both times.
clock.lockBody: Ask the desk to confirm the time and request ID in writing.
timeline.title: Your evidence timeline
timeline.subtitle: Keep query, document and call times together.
rights.title: What the rule says
contact.title: Contacts from official sources
contact.unavailable: A verified direct contact is not available here yet. Use IRDAI's official GRO list.
recovery.title: Charged extra for the wait?
recovery.body: Record extra room or nursing charges after discharge. Ask the insurer to review charges attributable to delay beyond three hours.
death.link: A patient has died — help with release
death.title: Help with release after a death
death.body: You do not need to manage a timer here. Ask the insurer and hospital desk to process the request immediately.
letter.title: Your message, ready to review
letter.note: Check the details. Add your name and claim ID yourself before sending. You are the complainant.
letter.copied: Copied. You can paste and send it.
letter.copyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Select the text or download it.
footer.disclaimer: Information, not legal advice. ClaimClock does not file complaints or guarantee a claim outcome.
footer.built: Made for the wait. Built for your privacy.
status.offline: You're offline. Your clock and saved messages still work.
error.time: Enter a valid submission time within the past 90 days, not in the future.
error.storage: This browser could not save your record. Download a backup before closing.
finished.title: Record the insurer's decision
finished.error: Decision time must be after submission and not in the future.
optin.title: Help make the wait visible
optin.body: Optional: share insurer, TPA, city, request type, submission/decision times and outcome. No name, hospital, documents or claim number. Reports stay for up to one year; public cells need at least 10 reports. Keep your deletion code to withdraw.
optin.consent: I am 18 or older and agree to share these fields for the patient-reported Delay Index.
optin.sent: Report received. Keep this deletion code:
optin.failed: The report was not sent. Your local timeline is safe. Try later.
bima.body: First complain to your insurer's GRO. Keep the acknowledgement. If unresolved within 14 days or you are unhappy with the reply, register on Bima Bharosa, paste your text and save the token. The portal may require your policy and identity details; enter those there yourself.
index.title: The Discharge Delay Index
index.body: What insurers publish about cashless turnaround times — alongside patient reports when there is enough data.
index.caution: A 2–6 hour bucket cannot tell us whether the 3-hour rule was met. These are disclosures, not a compliance ranking.
index.missing: Missing or unparseable filings are listed in the coverage register.
index.empty: No publishable patient sample yet (minimum 10 per cell).
index.sourceClock: The insurer's clock starts when the TPA receives the discharge bill. A family's wait may start earlier.
index.noData: No verified, parseable NL-48 row is available for this insurer yet.
index.units: Values are shown in the units published. Rounding is preserved. Different TPAs and periods are not combined.
about.title: Three small steps. A stronger record.
about.oneBody: Enter the time the desk says it sent the request. Add calls, queries and replies as they happen.
about.twoBody: Send the clock-lock message. Save the acknowledgement and request ID outside this app too.
about.threeBody: Review a source-linked draft. Send it yourself to the desk, insurer or grievance portal.
about.limit: Your phone's clock and entries can be changed. ClaimClock preserves a useful record; it does not certify when a hospital submitted a request.
deductions.title: Make the deductions add up.
deductions.body: Read your settlement letter on this device. Check each line, then ask for a clear reason and the policy clause.
rejected.title: Ask for a review of the rejection.
deductions.caution: This checks explanations, not your medical eligibility. Policy wording and the actual calculation decide whether a deduction applies.
deductions.uploadNote: Optional. PDF or photo; up to 20 MB and 20 pages per file. English OCR. Manual entry always works.
deductions.text: Document text — stays on this page
deductions.ocrWarning: OCR can miss amounts and rows. Check against the original. No diagnosis is inferred.
deductions.format: One line per deduction: reason | amount in rupees. Use the deducted amount, not the whole bill.
deductions.confirm: I checked the reasons and amounts against my documents.
deductions.resultsNote: “Challengeable” means ask for evidence and review. It does not mean a refund is owed.
deductions.noAi: A reason. A clause. A calculation.
deductions.noAiBody: You can request these without AI. No medical document needs to leave your phone.
deductions.aiNote: Only the preview below is sent to the configured AI provider. Check that names, policy numbers and UHIDs are removed. Automatic redaction can miss details.
deductions.aiPreview: The exact text that will be sent
deductions.aiConsent: I checked this text contains no identifying details and consent to sending it for this explanation.
deductions.reminderNote: Downloads reminders for day 14, day 30, and a provisional one-year limit. Verify the actual Ombudsman trigger; a reminder does not file a complaint.
deductions.complaintDate: Date you complained to the insurer
deductions.close: Document text is held in this page’s memory. Close or reload to clear it.
deductions.wait: Please wait for the current document to finish.
deductions.readDone: Read locally. Check the text and enter each deducted line below.
deductions.readFailed: Could not read this file. Manual entry still works.
deductions.policyConfirm: I checked this clause and the arithmetic against my policy and bill.
deductions.lineError: Check these line numbers. Use reason | amount
deductions.aiUnavailable: AI is unavailable or its free limit is reached. Your review and letters still work.
deductions.checkAgain: More identifiers were removed. Review the new preview and confirm again.
deductions.aiCaution: AI explanation only. Check it against your policy; the rule-based review above is unchanged.
deductions.calendarDone: Reminder file downloaded. Import it into your calendar and verify the dates.
deductions.dateError: Check the dates: no future dates; reply cannot precede the complaint.
clock.nextRunning: First, ask for written confirmation of the receipt time.
clock.nextHalfway: Half the window has passed. Your follow-up message is ready.
clock.nextBeyond: Your recorded wait is beyond the window. Review the GRO and billing-desk drafts below.
clock.nextDecided: Keep the decision and itemised bill with your timeline.
rejection.eyebrow: A WRITTEN REASON. A CLEAR NEXT STEP.
rejection.title: Ask for a review of your rejected claim.
rejection.body: Prepare a formal grievance to your insurer. Your details stay in this page until you choose to share the letter.
rejection.date: Date the rejection was communicated to you
rejection.private: Copy the stated reason without names or policy numbers. Add identifying details yourself to the final letter. Reload or close this page to clear your entries.
rejection.invalid: Check the insurer, a valid rejection date that is not in the future, and the stated reason.
rejection.gro: Send your grievance to the insurer’s GRO. Keep the acknowledgement and attachments. The insurer should resolve the complaint within 14 days.
rejection.bima: If unresolved, you can raise a complaint on Bima Bharosa. Keep its token. The insured or claimant files the complaint.
rejection.ombudsman: First complain to the insurer. An unsatisfactory or rejected grievance response, or no reply for one calendar month, can open the free Insurance Ombudsman route. One month is not always 30 days. File within one year of the applicable response or the expiry of that month. The limit is ₹50 lakh including expenses; check all eligibility conditions.
rejection.consumer: A Consumer Commission is another route; e-Jagriti is the online portal. The usual limit is two years from the cause of action. Check jurisdiction and dates. The same dispute must not be pending or decided in court, a consumer forum or arbitration for the Ombudsman route.
rejection.limit: A cashless refusal may differ from final claim repudiation. Ask the insurer which decision it made. This draft requests a review; it cannot decide coverage or guarantee payment.
rejection.filing: You review, sign and send every complaint yourself. ClaimClock does not contact the insurer or file a case for you.
rejection.rule.repudiation-review: A repudiation needs approval by the Product Management Committee or its three-member Claims Review Committee. Ask which body approved it and when.
rejection.rule.deduction-reasons: For a rejected or partly disallowed claim, ask for the full reasons and the exact policy terms for each disputed amount.
rejection.rule.grievance-14-days: The insurer must acknowledge your complaint immediately and should resolve it within 14 days, with reasons and policy terms if it is not accepted.
